text:
Lena: Heads-up: stakeholders requested an air-gapped signing ceremony doc plus forensic checklist before we cut the base-image rebuild for regulated customers.
Mira: Good call. Air-gapped flow needs clear steps: offline key custody, signed allowlist publish, and how customers verify without contacting our KMS.
Devon: For offline keys we can use cosign with a detached signature bundle signed by an operator HSM and publish the signer fingerprint to a signed allowlist blob. runtime verifier checks bundle fingerprint against allowlist.
Alex: Important: record a tamper-evident audit trail of the ceremony. include video + hash, ksl (key split logs), and a signed JSON manifest with who participated and when. store in secure audit GCS with restricted ACL.
Lena: Forensics section should spell out how to investigate suspected compromise: 1) snapshot registry metadata, 2) gather attestation predicates, 3) check builder VM logs and CI job history, 4) pull KMS audit trail.
Mira: Add a verification fallback for customers: if they can't reach our allowlist service, they load a local allowlist file provided during install; the customer must record its fingerprint and rotate manually. document how to import revocation updates later.
ops-bot: note: created ticket SEC-AG-001 - "airgap signing ceremony runbook" (auto)
Devon: RBAC for ceremony: at least 3 approvers from different groups (sec lead, platform eng, release manager) required to promote an offline key to prod allowlist. log approver identities and use MFA during ceremony.
Alex: Also include process for emergency key revocation: immediate update to allowlist (mark revoked), push notifier to private customer channels, and a forced runtime verifier refresh with high priority.
Lena: Add the performative checklist for ceremony day: hardware HSM present, notarization witness, recorded checksums, test-sign and verify on air-gapped verifier, publish allowlist artifact to ephemeral USB and transfer via courier with chain-of-custody form.
Mira: We should provide a small utility that validates an offline attestation against local allowlist and prints human-friendly failures (e.g., "ALLOWLIST_MISMATCH", "ATTESTATION_TTL_EXPIRED"). Ship as a static binary so air-gapped customers can run it.
Devon: For CI integration: CI produces SBOM + build metadata, writes to an artifacts bucket, operator pulls artifact into airgapped environment, performs signing, returns signed bundle which CI uploads back. All steps produce signed checkpoints in the audit object.
Alex: Add legal/compliance hook: include a statement template for customers that documents who had custody during signing and retention policy for raw keys. important for audits.
sec-bot: runbook fragment SSEC-airgap-runbook added to incidents/ (auto)
Lena: Open question - how long do we keep ceremony recordings and raw logs? compliance suggests 7 years for some regions. suggest default 3 years with option to extend per-contract.
Mira: Ok to default 3 years, but make retention configurable by customer contract. implement retention tag in audit blob metadata.
Devon: I'll prototype the offline allowlist format (signed JSON array of key fingerprints + rotation events) and a verifier binary that accepts --allowlist /path/to/allow.json. aim PoC by EOD Friday.
Alex: Assignments: Devon -> allowlist + verifier PoC, Mira -> ceremony runbook & checklist, Lena -> forensic playbook and retention policy draft. reconvene in 48h and lock the rollout for regulated customers. :white_check_mark:
